title: Context Trim: who is it actually for?
description:
Context Trim is for the people who aren't ready to start fresh yet.

When you're new and all your understanding — yours and the AI's — lives in one chat, starting over feels like losing everything.

Context Trim lets you selectively replace old turns with a compact summary so you stay lighter without starting from scratch.

From the full working session: https://youtube.com/watch?v=alOvTm5SpGI

#Valo #Claude #Codex #ContextTrim #AIcoding #vibecoding
